answer: A workable design charges newcomers upfront and refunds on merit. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the sable of free entry disappears, the whisper of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the knoll case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. One real contributor then costs less than one.
